Scope: road works, storm, sewer, potable water and TSE networks, electrical works, fence and gates, a bridge and landscaping. Contract value 86.8M SAR, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 72.6% against a plan of 47.0%, the project is 25.6% ahead (SPI 1.55). This week it gained 0.27% against 0.78% planned, so the lead narrowed slightly. Yet the schedule forecasts completion 184 days after the contract date.

Well ahead on progress, but the forecast finish is six months late. Both the weekly report and the P6 update forecast completion on 20-May-2028, 184 days after the contract completion date of 18-Nov-2027, with −157 days of total float. Every open milestone is forecast 7 days later than the latest plan date in the Milestones sheet. Roads and medium voltage, the WBS that is behind plan (73.5% against 100%), depends on the MV network, which is waiting for the MODON–SEC agreement; MV cable, ring main units and lighting substations have not been ordered.

Data notes

Built only from the 20-Oct-2026 weekly upload (W3); earlier weeks were not used.

  • Week number: the report states week 47.86 (whole weeks since site handover: 47); the file reference is WPR-048.
  • Physical progress differs between sheets: the dashboard shows 72.6% (518,858 of 714,561 man-hours), while the P6 export, the Physical-Chart Data sheet and Progress Certificate #01 show 74.0–74.1% (528,823 man-hours).
  • The weekly summary file (works executed this week) and the Look Ahead and Conclusion sheets label cost-based progress as "actual"; this report uses physical % complete (man-hours) only. The weekly summary file also gives project code JDH3-03-011, contract value 86,742,345 and an expected finish of 30-Nov-2026; the Look Ahead sheet also shows 30-Nov-2026. The dashboard and P6 forecast 20-May-2028.
  • MODON PM: Eng. Abdallah Aljulayfi in the General Information sheet; م. رضا المنشاوي in the Look Ahead sheet and the weekly summary file.
  • Milestones: the dashboard panel's "Original (Baseline)" column shows latest-plan dates (e.g. project finish 13-May-2028), and the Milestones sheet gives finish mobilization a baseline of 11-Nov-2025, before project start; the P6 baseline (18-Dec-2025) is used here. P6 and the weekly report swap the roads/MV and deep-network dates.
  • Invoices: the summary says 6 submitted invoices, but the log lists 7 and the 44,851,849 total includes the seventh. Approved and paid amounts include 15% VAT, while the submitted total is gross; the Conclusion sheet labels the same contract value (86,782,345) as both including and excluding VAT.
  • HDPE pipes: the Major Quantities sheet does not name the network; potable water and TSE are inferred from quantities. Installed quantities differ from the Material Monitoring sheet (potable 12,075 vs 12,045 m; TSE 8,700 vs 8,772 m), and TSE delivery (8,722 m) exceeds its revised BOQ (8,502 m).
  • Equipment cumulative actual stays at 564 from July although monthly counts continue. Several dashboard cells show #REF! errors (milestone panel, safety and quality scores in the Codes sheet).
  • Procurement sheet: some purchase-order dates fall after delivery (e.g. fiberglass manholes PO 29-Dec-2026, UPVC pipes PO 18-Dec-2026), which look like year typos.
